description: Held topics: subjects the knowledge base does not cover safely yet, answered with a neutral signpost instead of a retrieved entry, until a clinician approves content. Used by src/heldTopics.js; scripts/build-held-topics.js copies the groups into the offline queryRules.ts, and a test fails if the copy is out of date. Written by hand from general vocabulary, by category, after the demo-risk results (docs/testing/demo-risk-results.csv) had been seen; not from any test query. Patterns are lowercase, written as the rule normalises a query (apostrophes and punctuation removed): a single word matches as written or with a plural 's' or 'es' added or removed; 'a b' is a phrase, matched as consecutive words; 'a+b' matches when every word is in the query, in any order. Groups are checked in order, so a query matching both gets group A's reply. Decision: docs/decision-log.md, 'Held-topic rule (2026-10-20)'.

groups.name: after sex or contraception failure
groups.criterion: Emergency contraception by name or description, a condom that failed, a missed or late pill, withdrawal, sex without protection, or pre-ejaculate: situations where the safe answer depends on timing and individual advice.

groups.name: pregnancy decisions
groups.criterion: A positive pregnancy test, an unwanted or unplanned pregnancy, or ending a pregnancy: decisions that need private, non-judgemental counselling.
patterns: do not want to be pregnant
